title: Quality inspections
description: Checklists per location and contractor, with pass / conditional / fail outcomes and follow-up defects.

items.membrane_continuous: Membrane continuous, no tears or blisters
items.overlaps_sealed: Overlaps and joints sealed to specification
items.upstands_height: Upstands and wall turn-ups at required height
items.drains_detailed: Drains and penetrations detailed and sealed

items.formwork_dimensions: Formwork dimensions and levels per drawings
items.rebar_per_drawings: Reinforcement diameter, spacing and laps per drawings
items.embedded_items: Sleeves, conduits and embedded items fixed
items.pour_logistics: Mix order, pump and vibrators confirmed

items.panel_location: Panel location and clearances per plan
items.breakers_rating: Breakers and RCDs rated per single-line diagram
items.earthing_bonding: Earthing and bonding connected and tested
items.cover_closed: Covers, blanks and IP rating intact

items.system_isolated: Section isolated and open ends capped
items.hold_duration: Pressure held for the required duration without drop
items.no_visible_leaks: No visible leaks at joints and fittings
items.test_record_signed: Test record signed by the contractor

items.services_complete: All above-ceiling services installed and tested
items.access_panels: Access panels positioned for valves and equipment
items.mep_signoff: MEP trades signed off for closure

items.signage: Exit signage and emergency lighting working

items.glazing_intact: Glazing intact, correct type and labels
items.hardware_operation: Sashes, handles and locks operate smoothly
items.drainage_slots: Drainage slots clear; water test passed
